title: AIoT and edge inference

spans.text: LESSON PURPOSE

Goal: apply “AIoT and edge inference” to a real program or device. The key principle is: Quantization can reduce memory and compute, but accuracy must be measured again. In a project, follow this guidance: Evaluate models on real sensor conditions, including noisy and missing data.
QUESTION: What will this example do? Predict the result first.
EXAMPLE CODE
EXPECTED RESULT
Example inference record; predicted class and confidence depend on the model and normalized sensor input.
CORE EXPLANATION
Edge inference runs on a device or gateway and may reduce sensitive raw-data transfer. Measure model size, RAM/flash, latency, energy, and error rates.
IMPORTANT LINE BREAKDOWN
Key line:
{"model":"quantized","input":"normalized sensor window","output":"class and confidence"}

What it does: Quantization can reduce memory and compute, but accuracy must be measured again.
Why it is used: Evaluate models on real sensor conditions, including noisy and missing data.
If omitted or changed: Do not treat model output as certainty; define a safe fallback for low confidence and faulty sensors.
